ruling: self-initiated: three of the four blockers n500 recorded were reasoned rather than looked up, and this run has already turned one of my own failures to look into a claimed defect in the data.
population: the four cells n500 reports as not producible
criterion: verified-blocked / bounded / needs-ruling / needs-extraction, each with what was actually inspected

controlProbes.why: A pattern that matches nothing and a corpus that contains nothing both count zero; a pattern that matches everything yields an impressive-looking upper bound. Both directions are checked before any bound is reported.

POP_WORDING_UNCLEAR_N.criterion: opinion == unclear 且理由文字含「族群」或 population
POP_WORDING_UNCLEAR_N.whyNotExact: 該格要的是「**僅**卡族群措辭」者。⚠️ 抽樣讀過之理由多半同時寫著對照臂、劑量、摘要缺漏等其他卡點——🚨 「僅」這個字要靠逐筆讀理由才判得出來，🚫 不是檢索。
POP_WORDING_UNCLEAR_N.whyUsefulAnyway: ⚠️ 「產不出」與「產得出一個界」在交付時是兩件事：🚨 上界說得出「至多這麼多」，而那已足以判斷它會不會影響結論。
POP_WORDING_UNCLEAR_N.patternCaveat: 🚨 以中文字樣認定，措辭換了就漏——⚠️ 故這是**該樣式下**之上界。

SEX_SAMPLE_COMPOSITION.whatWasChecked: 逐一列出 queue 條目之欄位聯集，並清點 abstract-enrichment 之涵蓋筆數。
SEX_SAMPLE_COMPOSITION.finding: 🚨 queue 之欄位裡**沒有任何一個**與受試者組成有關（僅題名、識別碼、分數、旗標、分層）；⚠️ 摘要另存 3357 筆，🚨 但由摘要判定性別組成仍是閱讀，🚫 不是取欄位。
SEX_SAMPLE_COMPOSITION.correction: ⚠️ `n500` 原記其阻礙為 needs-extraction——**結論不變，但當時是推的**；🚨 本檔實查後改記為 verified-blocked，並附所查之欄位清單。

TITLE_ONLY_EXPECTED_GAP.finding: ⚠️ 資料齊全（名冊 175 筆在手），🚨 卡的是「該用哪個率去推導」——n+121 已裁定舊率不得直接套用，而新率尚未指定。

HARMS_S5_ACTUAL.finding: 🚨 該值須萃取判讀後才存在；⚠️ 且 n+147 明訂「GI 是否為主要結局」正是 S5 要量的東西，🚫 不得由取得端順手做掉。

rootProvenance.note: Recorded so a truncated source shows up as a smaller number rather than passing silently. The preflight can tell a missing root from a present one; it cannot tell a complete root from a half-copied one.

coverageStatement: The bound is a bound under one Chinese wording pattern; differently worded reasons are missed, so it bounds what that pattern can see. The word "only" in "blocked only by population wording" is a reading of each reason and is left to a reader rather than approximated.
contentNote: Counts and field names only. No reason text is stored.
